name: claude-tools
description: Small, sharp add-ons for Claude Code: a live task progress bar, session status markers, a usage limits monitor for one or more accounts, and sidebar folders with your own names.

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: A live progress bar above the prompt for Claude's to-do list: see how many steps are done, which one is running now, and when the whole job is finished. Works in the terminal and the desktop app.

plugins.name: account-status
plugins.description: Watch your Claude usage limits live: 5-hour and weekly use with reset times, plus each chat's context window and current work, for one account or several, in the /accounts panel.

plugins.name: session-status
plugins.description: See at a glance which Claude chats are working ⏳, need you 💬, are done ✅ or failed ⚠️: a live marker and step count on each chat in the desktop app's sidebar, plus a /sessions board of every chat. No pop-ups.

plugins.name: sidebar-folders
plugins.description: Organize your Claude desktop chats into folders with your own names. New chats sort themselves by project or title words, chats Claude starts follow their parent, and /folder moves any chat.
